name: EAP items: Kafka snuba-items to BigQuery
description: Reads sentry_protos.snuba.v1.TraceItem protobufs from Kafka and writes rows to BigQuery eap.items.

parameters.name: sample_rate
parameters.label: Pipeline sample rate
parameters.helpText: Fraction of traces to keep, in (0, 1]. Default 1.0.

parameters.name: sample_seed
parameters.label: Sampling seed
parameters.helpText: Salt for the trace_id hash. Default empty.

parameters.name: start_offset
parameters.label: Start offset policy
parameters.helpText: Kafka auto.offset.reset (latest | earliest), used only when the consumer group has no committed offset. Default latest.

parameters.name: start_read_time_ms
parameters.label: Force start time (epoch ms)
parameters.helpText: If >= 0, ignore committed offsets and start all partitions at this broker timestamp. Default -1 (off).

parameters.name: triggering_frequency_seconds
parameters.label: Exactly-once commit interval
parameters.helpText: Seconds. Only used with STORAGE_WRITE_API_EXACTLY_ONCE. Default 5.

parameters.name: dead_letter_path
parameters.label: Dead-letter GCS prefix
parameters.helpText: gs://bucket/prefix for JSONL dead-letter files. Empty = log + counter only.

parameters.name: dead_letter_window_seconds
parameters.label: Dead-letter file window
parameters.helpText: Seconds per dead-letter file window. Default 300.

parameters.name: kafka_consumer_config
parameters.label: Extra Kafka consumer config
parameters.helpText: JSON object of extra consumer properties. Default {}.
